pages.text: The Wayroot is a graft kept under a copper arm. Pale bark holds it in shape. Fungal tissue feels for distant traces, and amber carries the Resonance between them. The copper guides where that current can go.
pages.title: The threshold
An address
pages.text: Choose a charter and read its requirements before sealing it. The graft can find an address and a way home. It cannot promise safe footing.

pages.title: Before entry
pages.text: The desk can open a small aperture above itself. A grafted arch draws it down into a doorway. Take food, a weapon and room for cargo. Entering issues the route compass.

pages.title: Before entry
pages.text: Guests can join an open party until the first checkpoint. Set Party access to Solo Expedition to keep the portal private. First Bearing is always private and teaches two marks and a return.

pages.title: Bind a doorway
pages.text: Make the posts from birch logs and a dormant flake. Stand facing the Wayroot. Immediately to your right, build a post three upright Pale Graft Posts tall. Leave a one-block gap, then build a second matching post. Set the Graft

pages.title: Bind a doorway
pages.text: Collar at the top of the gap.

pages.title: Bind a doorway
pages.text: Keep both blocks beneath the collar clear, with solid ground at the foot. Seal a charter to wake the arch. The first witness stump closes the aperture, leaving the timber in place.
Place it facing a safe space. A grafted arch can carry the aperture beside the desk.
